family_name: Proctor Passive Rainscreen with Integrated Tape

spec.description:
ProctorPassive Rainscreen (such as Rainscreen FR-Zero with
Integrated Tape / IT) is an extra heavy-duty, vapour-permeable water and air
barrier membrane engineered specifically for open-joint rainscreen facades.
Formulated with zero halogen flame retardants, it achieves an AS 1530.1
non-combustibility index or Group 1 fire rating and is UV-stabilised to
withstand permanent solar exposure behind open joints up to 50mm wide. The
integrated tape system provides dual adhesive-to-adhesive sealing along
horizontal overlaps, accelerating installation and ensuring continuous airtight
and weathertight integrity.
features:
Engineered for open-joint cladding
with up to 40% open area and 50mm gap widths

Integrated tape (IT) provides
adhesive-to-adhesive lap sealing along edges

Vapour permeable Class 4 rating
allows internal moisture vapour to breathe outward

Water barrier and air
barrier preventing rain and wind infiltration

Halogen-free fire-retardant
formulation compliant with AS 1530.2 and AS 1530.1 / AS 5637.1

High tensile
and tear strength classified as Extra Heavy Duty

High UV resistance ensuring
long-term stability behind open cladding slats

Deep solid black finish
creates a clean shadow line behind open facade joints

Suitable for commercial
and residential timber or steel frame constructions

technical.value:

spec.compliance: AS/NZS 4200.1:2017, AS/NZS 4200.2:2017, AS 1530.2, NCC 2022 Volume One & Two
spec.sustainability:
Halogen-free flame retardants, recyclable polyolefin
components, low VOC
install:
Install horizontally over wall framing or
external rigid sheathing with black face outward

Fix mechanically using
broad-head screws with washers or cap nails at maximum 300mm centres

Ensure
horizontal runs overlap by a minimum of 150mm

Peel back release liner from
the integrated adhesive tape on the overlapping edges

Press the two
integrated tape strips firmly together using a squeegee to form an airtight
bond

Stagger vertical joints by minimum 150mm over a stud and seal with
compatible black rainscreen tape

Seal all window, door, and service
penetrations to complete the continuous weather envelope

Ensure facade
cladding open gaps do not exceed 50mm width or 40% open area
selection_checklist:
Confirm cladding system is an open-joint rainscreen
facade

Verify maximum facade gap width does not exceed 50mm and 40% open
area
Confirm requirement for integrated tape (IT) for faster lap sealing

Check fire compliance requirements for external wall (AS 1530.2 Flammability
Index ≤ 5)
Order matching black rainscreen patch tape for penetrations
limitations:
Do not exceed maximum 50mm gap
width or 40% open area in facade cladding

Must be separated from cladding by
an unblocked drainage cavity

Not designed for roof sarking or horizontal
applications

retrieval.rag_summary:
ProctorPassive Rainscreen
with Integrated Tape is an Extra Heavy Duty, Class 4 vapour-permeable weather
barrier engineered for open-joint rainscreen facades with up to 40% open area
and 50mm gap widths. Formulated with high UV stabilisers and halogen-free fire
retardants (Flammability Index ≤ 5 to AS 1530.2), it presents a deep black
shadow finish behind open cladding. Equipped with factory-applied integrated
adhesive tape along overlaps, it forms a durable airtight and watertight barrier
while allowing moisture vapour to escape from wall cavities.
